# AffineDrift

> Control-affine golf swing research, educational textbooks, and a governed companion catalog for UpstreamDrift models.

Read notation and conventions before theory pages; use the programming companion catalog for UpstreamDrift model and engine maps.

## Notation and Conventions

## Repository and Agent Policy
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Fleet agent coding standards, CI gates, and Quarto authoring rules for this repository.
- [NOTATION.md](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/NOTATION.md): Authoritative symbol, sign, and control-affine terminology source for the site registry.

## Notation, Conventions, and Parameters
- [Mathematical Notation and Terminology](https://affinedrift.com/pages/notation.html): Rendered NOTATION.md: drift, control, ZTCF/ZVCF, DCR, frames, and overload rules.
- [Canonical Parameters Reference](https://affinedrift.com/pages/parameters.html): Parameter symbols, units, and admissible ranges for textbook models.
- [Governance Vocabulary Glossary](https://affinedrift.com/pages/glossary.html): Plain-language and technical definitions with stable def-* anchors.

## Theory and Model Maps
- [Theory Part 1: Affine Control Interpretation](https://affinedrift.com/articles/theory-part1.html): Primary control-affine state representation; opts in to symbol hover registry.
- [Zero-Torque Counterfactual Family](https://affinedrift.com/articles/zero-torque-counterfactual.html): ZTCF constructions (pointwise, stitched, forward, branched) and frozen-plant rules.
- [Drift-Control Ratio](https://affinedrift.com/articles/drift-control-ratio.html): Canonical DCR definition, weighting, admissible control set, and regularizer.
- [Lagrangian Reference](https://affinedrift.com/articles/lagrangian-reference.html): Derivation of control-affine manipulator dynamics and mass-matrix structure.

## Programming Companion and Engine Protocol
- [Programming Companion Index](https://affinedrift.com/models/programming/index.html): Pinned UpstreamDrift companion catalog entry point.
- [Engines](https://affinedrift.com/models/programming/engines.html): Physics engine roster, tiers, and equivalency contract references.
- [Programs](https://affinedrift.com/models/programming/programs.html): Declared executable programs and surfaces from the pinned companion manifest.
- [Workflows](https://affinedrift.com/models/programming/workflows.html): Companion workflow identifiers and governance metadata.
- [Provenance](https://affinedrift.com/models/programming/provenance.html): Provider pin, schema version, and acquisition record for the active companion lock.

## Claims and Evidence
- [Scientific Claims Ledger](https://affinedrift.com/evidence/claims.html): Human-readable projection of the governed claim registry.
- [Claim registry (JSON)](https://affinedrift.com/data/trust/claim_registry.json): Machine-readable claim ids, evidence paths, and adjudication status.

## Machine-Readable Registries
- [Symbol registry](https://affinedrift.com/data/symbol_references.json): Equation symbols generated from NOTATION.md
- [Canonical pages manifest](https://affinedrift.com/data/agent/canonical_pages.json): Structured list of agent entry pages

## Optional
- [Repository README](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/README.md): Build commands and local development
- [SPEC.md](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/blob/main/SPEC.md): Repository specification and architecture pointers
